tables.title: NOR/PSRAM External memory address
columns: Data address issued to the memory
tables.text: Table 151, "NOR/PSRAM External memory address", in section 27.7.1 (NOR/PSRAM address mapping) on page 1182. Columns: (1)Memory width, Data address issued to the memory, Maximum memory capacity (bits). 3 data row(s). Notes: 1. In case of a 16-bit external memory width, the FMC internally uses ADDR[25:1] to generate the address for external memory FMC_A[24:0]. In case of a 32-bit memory width, the FMC internally uses ADDR.

headers: Data address issued to the memory
notes: 1. In case of a 16-bit external memory width, the FMC internally uses ADDR[25:1] to generate the address for external memory FMC_A[24:0]. In case of a 32-bit memory width, the FMC internally uses ADDR[25:2] to generate the external address. Whatever the external memory width, FMC_A[0] must be connected to external memory address A[0].
